name: The A-Maze Game
author: Addicting Games
description: Maze is a free puzzle game. The real maze is real-life. It is all around you at all times and you are forever lost. Is this the right way? Is that the right choice? Have you found a way out or just another dead end? In real life, you may never know but in Maze the answer is clear. Find yourself out of a  series of puzzling mazes in this exciting maze game that gives you only a small peek at your surroundings and asks you to make a simple choice: left or right, up or down. That is it. But once you make enough of these choices and you make them fast enough you'll find your way traversing the maze, making it to the end, and out the other side. Victory is yours, but was it fast enough? Most people find their way out but barely any of them do it in time. If you want to be a winner, a real winner, then you have to optimize every choice and make it out the exit as fast as you can. Maze is a game that will take you on a trip.
